responsibility: Declares the on-demand type-query utility used across the Rust typechecker. The query_type entry point resolves a HIR id to its TyTy type through the shared TypeCheckContext and lazy item-resolution machinery, without exposing the details of which resolver handles the underlying HIR node kind.
same_name_distinction: Provides only the declaration of the query_type helper for this stem, hiding the resolver-dispatch details that are implemented in the paired .cc file.
